criteria.rationale: Verified facts: the only producer is review_bundle.go:1816; sealing refuses blockers at review_bundle.go:2082 and includes child blockers at :547; sealedInputsThatDiffer does not compare Children; closeout blocks non-terminal children (review_closeout.go:2671,2692). Unresolved: no end-to-end dispatch test (F2) and the milestone 'does not stand' case (F3). Accepted risk: the roadmap reviewer does not see the children's review records.
The change is a pure slice filter with no shared state, goroutines or lifecycle; the unit suite passed.
No public API, file or MCP contract changes; only an internal dispatch filter.
Other blockers still fail the run with the 'sealed checkout blocked' message; the test keeps three of them.
Sealing and closeout still judge the children; only the in-worktree recheck drops the blocker.
The failure message for the remaining blockers is unchanged and bounded.
Examined the diff: no CLI, file or MCP contract changes; behaviour only becomes less strict in the worktree recheck, which sealing already enforces.
The filter drops both forms of the child blocker and keeps the others; the next step (sealedInputsThatDiffer) does not compare Children, so the fix takes effect.

Root cause: Subject.Head comes before the commits holding the children's review records, and sameRoadmapApartFromLifecycle forbids reordering. D1 drops only the blocker the worktree cannot satisfy and keeps it at sealing and closing.
